data.name: Shaban
data.long_meaning: Shaban is the name of the eighth month in the Islamic calendar. The word comes from Arabic ‘sha‘ba’, meaning ‘to disperse’ or ‘to separate’, signifying the time when Arab tribes dispersed to find water. The month of Shaban is spiritually significant in Islam.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of preparation and reflection before Ramadan. A month blessed with opportunities for forgiveness and mercy.
data.numerology_meaning: Number 8 symbolizes purpose, discipline, and spiritual strength. Shaban reflects spiritual readiness and wisdom.

in_arabic.name: شعبان
in_arabic.long_meaning: شعبان هو الشهر الثامن في التقويم الهجري، وله أهمية كبيرة في الإسلام، حيث يأتي بعد شهر رجب المُكرَّم، ويتصل بالشهر المعظم رمضان المبارك، ويشير إلى انتهاء الشتاء وبداية الصيف، ويتسم بالرحمة والبركة

in_urdu.name: شعبان
in_urdu.long_meaning: شعبان ہجری تقویم کا آٹھواں مہینہ ہے، جس کی اسلام میں بڑی اہمیت ہے، رجب المُکرَّم کے بعد آتا ہے، اور رمضان المبارک سے جڑا ہوا ہے، سرما کے خاتمے اور گرما کے آغاز کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، اور رحمت اور برکت سے معطر ہے

data.cultural_impact: Shaban holds cultural significance as it is the month when the early Arab tribes once embarked on long journeys to seek water for their livestock, leading to the name ‘sha‘ba’ meaning ‘to disperse’ or ‘to separate’. The same spirit of journeys and exploration resonates in contemporary Islamic societies, as students and professionals travel to new places to learn, work, or seek experiences.
data.spiritual_significance: The month of Shaban has spiritual importance in Islamic belief. It is considered a month of Mercy and forgiveness, a preparation period before the holy month of Ramadan. During this time, Muslims are encouraged to dedicate their energies more to remembrance of Allah (zikr). There is also a strong focus on good deeds and self-reflection, warding off sin and seeking forgiveness through prayer and repentance. The spiritual practices and intention setting during Shaban ultimately sets a solid foundation for the personal growth and renewal during Ramadan.
